note: P3809 (Pro 5:21) — a man's ways are before the LORD's eyes; he ponders all his paths. (God's weighing — external:god.)

dims.v: divine scrutiny — the LORD weighs all of a man's paths
the LORD's weighing/appraising of every one of a man's ways, all exposed before him
the divine appraisal under which all conduct lies

palas (weigh/make level/ponder) — here the LORD's action: he 'weighs' all a man's tracks. The same verb the son must apply to himself (4:26) God applies to all. Locus external:god — the total divine scrutiny that frames human accountability, not a human interior.
